messages:
Rina (docs): Quick heads-up: opened a tiny PR to clarify 'soft quota' vs 'hard quota' language in billing docs and to add a minimal SDK snippet showing the new metering header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6570 :wave:
Omar (billing): Thanks. Can you confirm whether "soft quota" consumption appears in the dashboard the same way as billed usage? Customers keep asking if their soft quota burn shows in 'consumed' graphs.
Rina (docs): Good question. I added a one-liner: soft quota is a temporary allowance applied to cumulative consumption for the billing period and appears in the dashboard as a separate series "soft_allocation_used" so it does show up, but it is visually distinct from billed_consumed.
Kai (devex): Can you paste the JS + Python snippets here? I want to ensure header casing and examples match SDK conventions.
Rina (docs): Pasted small examples below (plain examples only):
```js
// Node fetch example: include metering header (lowercase)
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'authorization': 'Bearer $KEY', 'x-rw-meter': 'inference_unit' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' })
});
```
```python
# Python requests example
import requests
headers = { 'authorization': 'Bearer ' + KEY, 'x-rw-meter': 'inference_unit' }
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=headers, json={'prompt':'hi'})
```
Omar (billing): One more: please add the conversion formula so CS can map tokens -> IU. Suggest: IU = ceil(tokens / 128). Also mention that billed_consumed excludes soft credits until billing reconciliation.
Asha (support): Can someone draft a 2-sentence reply we can paste to customers? Example: "Soft quota is a temporary allowance shown separately in the dashboard (series: soft_allocation_used). It does not change your per-second rate limit; rate limiting is enforced by the configured rate_window regardless of soft quota."
Rina (docs): Added Asha's wording verbatim to the PR. Also added a tiny pseudo-SQL snippet for the dashboard panel: 
```
SELECT ts, SUM(billed_consumed) AS billed, SUM(soft_allocation_used) AS soft
FROM billing_usage
WHERE meter_name = 'inference_unit' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
```
Kai (devex): LGTM. Suggest we standardize header to lowercase in all examples and link to the SDK helper that sets the meter header automatically.
Rina (docs): Switched to lowercase headers across examples and added a cross-link to the Node/Go SDK helper page. Preview build: https://deploy.preview.redwood.company/docs/billing/soft-quota-explain :white_check_mark:
Omar (billing): Approved from billing. Two tiny nits: add an explicit note that soft quota can be exhausted before billing cycle end and that it does not grant extra per-second throughput.
Asha (support): Thanks team, this will save us time. When merged can you paste the short customer reply to the support #snippets doc?
PreviewBot: PR #6570 merged to main, site deploy queued.
Rina (docs): Will backport to v1.9 and drop the CS snippet in #snippets once the deploy finishes. Thanks!
